reason: One review requests a Modern Mandarin pair for 𢇅 and 關, but the cited evidence does not support that correction: X-d72e2b774dfecc77edb4 reports 𢇅’s reading tradition and explicitly says it is not an independent historical reconstruction, while X-df924ae1831f4418f3a4 gives guān only for 關. The dossier also notes that the exact U+221C5 reading was not verified and readings for distinct 𢇇 cannot be transferred. Resolving this required finding needs new, character-specific reading evidence; the fanqie wording clarification alone is editable.
